user.title: Practice
user.description: Paste the practice's booking page link from HotDoc (for example {hotdoc_example}) or EasyVisit (for example {easyvisit_example}). A HotDoc link to one doctor's page preselects that doctor. You can also enter an EasyVisit location ID.

data.location: Booking link or EasyVisit location ID
